title: Chapter 887
text:
The dynasty's encirclement team was gathered in a military area, which was a crucial Interstellar Field teleportation node. The military stargate station here was directly connected to the Primeval Star River.

The stargate network of the three Universal Civilizations extended in all directions. With the Central Galaxy as the center, the stargate network connected all the Star Fields. This was one of the foundations of maintaining their dominance.

After waiting for a few days, the other dynasty allies who participated in the operation arrived one after another. After the seven of them arrived, they all boarded the flagship of the dynasty fleet.

In the command room of the bridge, the seven of them gathered together and greeted each other.

Everyone's relationship was different, but since it was a cooperative operation, it was necessary for them to get to know each other.

During Han Xiao's first trip to the dynasty's mother planet, Kohler had also been present, and the two of them had met before. However, Lotus Swordsman was the dynasty ally who had met for the first time.

"Your Excellency Black Star." Lotus Swordsman nodded slightly. Her white hair was tied into a long braid, and her expression was cold and indifferent.

"Hello, this must be the first time we've met." Han Xiao also greeted her politely and extended his hand.

Lotus Swordsman lowered her eyes and glanced at Han Xiao's outstretched hand. She hesitated for a while and shook her head, not intending to shake his hand.

"I don't like anyone touching my body. Sorry."

"Understood." Han Xiao did not mind and retracted his hand. Many Beyond Grade As had different habits, so he respected her wishes.

This time, Milizaus' magic avatar came over and patted Han Xiao's shoulder. "Your Excellency Lotus is our main point of attack in this operation. Her psychic ability is very unique and has extremely strong psychic penetration."

"It's not that exaggerated." Lotus Swordsman shook her head and said calmly, "EsGod also has a psychic Esper Ability that can protect his soul."

"At least compared to other aspects, the soul is one of EsGod's few weaknesses."

Hearing this, Han Xiao nodded and agreed. Including his doppelganger, he had fought EsGod three times. Together with the information from his previous life, he had a good understanding of EsGod's abilities.

EsGod's scariest advantage was that he had collected all kinds of Esper Abilities, so he had almost no shortcomings.

He had high mobility abilities such as' Dimension Crack 'and' Teleportation ', as well as abilities such as' Strong Self-Healing 'and' Black Hole 'to ensure the safety of his physical body. He also had all kinds of powerful attack, control, defense, transformation, and mental Esper Abilities. Compared to his physical body, EsGod's soul was not that strong, so attacking from the soul level was more efficient.

After chatting for a while, the commander of the fleet walked in. He saluted the seven Beyond Grade As and said with a deep voice,

"The fleet is ready. If there are no other questions, we will head to the Primeval Star River."

As one of the Empire's Three Pillars, Milizaus had the highest status in the team. He glanced around, and seeing that no one had any objections, he exchanged glances with Han Xiao and nodded.

"Let's go."

"Alright."

The commander came before the control panel and issued an order in the entire fleet channel. With a solemn expression, he said with a deep voice, "The EsGod encirclement operation has officially begun. All troops, move out!"

The dynasty fleet moved out, and the battleships spat out propulsion flames as they entered the stargate one after another.

At this moment, Han Xiao's expression changed slightly.

Just as the commander announced the start of the operation, a mission notification popped up on his interface … and there were two of them!

The first mission was [Dynasty Battle Campaign: Fallen Ark (Repeatable)]. This was a faction series mission that could be refreshed repeatedly, and Han Xiao had done it once before.

The small objectives in the mission were to kill different numbers and types of Fallen Ark members, and the mission with the most rewards was to deal with EsGod.

Reducing a certain amount of EsGod's health would give him a huge amount of Experience and Dynasty Contribution Points, and destroying an EsGod doppelganger would reward him with an EsGod Descent Card. Han Xiao's EsGod Character Summon Card was obtained from this mission.

The second mission was [Mortal Enemy of the Three Universal Civilizations].

[Mortal Enemy of the Three Universal Civilizations]

Mission Introduction: Chaos gives birth to order, and order gives birth to chaos. They transform each other but also oppose each other. The three Universal Civilizations rule the explored universe and are the embodiment of the established order, while EsGod is the spokesperson of chaos and violence. He pursues strength by hook or by crook, and he has been given titles such as' Slaughterer of Life ',' Guide of the Crazy Believers', and so on. All the criminals in the universe are gathered under his command, spreading fear throughout the universe. The three Universal Civilizations are always thinking of getting rid of this cancer of the universe, and for this goal, they have once again united today, and you have participated in this glorious operation.

Mission Requirements: Follow the three Universal Civilizations to deal with EsGod.

Reward: According to the damage dealt to EsGod (Both the main body and doppelganger can be dealt, and it will be calculated as a percentage of HP), you will receive a Random Reward when you reach 20%, and you will receive a [Character Summon Card — EsGod] when you reach 75%. If you deal more than 100% of EsGod's HP, it will only be counted as 100%.

Additional Mission Requirements: Cooperate with the three Universal Civilizations and successfully capture or kill EsGod.

Additional Reward: Randomly draw three of EsGod's abilities. Each time, you can choose a specific type of ability or talent, and it can be drawn three times or all at once.

"It's out." Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

Indeed, with the three Universal Civilizations working together to annihilate EsGod, it was impossible for there not to be a mission for such a big event.

He had done the first mission before, so he looked away after a glance. The second mission was the main one, and it seemed to have been triggered by the joint operation.

The joint operation of the three Universal Civilizations was largely driven by him, so it could be said that he had created this mission himself.

EsGod was full of treasures, and the reward for randomly drawing his abilities was extremely generous. Furthermore, the random draw mechanism this time was different from the previous missions.

In the past, the type of ability could not be chosen, and talents and abilities would be drawn together. This time, it was more targeted. There was also a breakthrough in the number of chances, reaching three. Furthermore, unlike the previous one-time draw, this time it could be drawn three times. This meant that the maximum number of random options had increased from five to fifteen, and there were more possibilities.

However, the more generous the reward, the more difficult it would be.

The strength of the evolved EsGod was unknown. While Han Xiao was happy, he was also worried about the success rate of this operation.

Han Xiao looked at everyone. The other dynasty allies had calm expressions. Although they knew that they were going to deal with EsGod, they did not show any signs of urgency. Among everyone, only he knew what it meant if they could defeat EsGod.

This might be a battle that concerned the fate of the entire explored universe!

It also concerned whether he could develop steadily.

In order to eliminate the hidden danger of the World Tree, even if there was no reward, he had to defeat EsGod.

Thinking of this, Han Xiao calmed down.

"The dynasty has already created enough favorable conditions. The rest will depend on the actual operation …"

…

The Primeval Star River was a vast Star Field, even larger than the Shattered Star Ring. It was divided into thirty-one Star Clusters, controlled by four Supercluster Civilizations. Its prosperity was comparable to the Sea of Star Spirits, and it was in the second tier of the universe. The first tier was the Central Galaxy.

Because the three Universal Civilizations strictly controlled the Central Galaxy, there were countless organizations in the second tier Star Fields like the Primeval Star River. For example, the headquarters of the Ancient Ones was located in the Primeval Star River.

In history, the Primeval Star River had its glory days. During the exploration era, it was the headquarters of a quasi-Universal Civilization. This civilization was a strong competitor of the three Universal Civilizations back then. Unfortunately, they did not survive the exploration era war and disappeared.

At that time, many local Star Cluster and Star System civilizations were also destroyed in the war, leaving behind many ruins. In terms of the number of ruins, the Primeval Star River was second only to the Ancient Star Desert. Similarly, there were many desolate universe belts, which were densely distributed.

Because they had a mission, the dynasty fleet did not delay and arrived at the rendezvous point.

A few days later, the teams from the Radiant Federation and the Arcane Church finally arrived and met up with the dynasty fleet.

Han Xiao also saw the people sent by the other two organizations.

Three from the Arcane Church.

One from the Radiant Federation.

Including the dynasty, there were a total of eleven Beyond Grade As!
